📌 Governance Quorum: Why a Vote Can Fail Even With a Majority

Main Points
⏺ Quorum is the minimum participation required for a decision to pass
⏺ Even if most voters choose “yes,” a proposal can fail without enough turnout
⏺ This post explains why DAOs need participation, not just votes

1️⃣ Core Idea — quorum protects a protocol from decisions made by a tiny group.
2️⃣ Example — if only a few wallets vote, the result may be technically “yes” but weakly representative.
3️⃣ Why It Matters — important changes should pass with meaningful participation from holders or delegates.
4️⃣ Risk Surface — quorum that is too high can freeze decisions, while quorum that is too low makes governance vulnerable.
5️⃣ Practical Check — when judging a DAO, review quorum rules, vote distribution, and delegate activity.

Final Thoughts

Governance is not only about who won. It also matters how many people showed up. Without quorum, a majority can be too small to count.

⚠️ Japan finance firms add AI translation and QR payments 

📊 PayPay has added UnionPay QR payments across participating Japanese merchants while SMBC has begun deploying an OpenAI-powered interpreter to bank employees. The two companies have not announced a partnership between the products. PayPay’s expansion concerns payments made by overseas visitors, while SMBC’s application handles spoken communication between bank employees and customers.

📣 Travelers can register UnionPay cards issued in mainland China, Hong Kong or Macau within the UnionPay App. At participating PayPay merchants, they can scan or present a payment code to complete purchases through the HIVEX network. PayPay said the service can be used for purchases such as meals, accommodations and souvenirs. Prices appear in Japanese yen at the merchant, while the customer’s application calculates the amount in their home currency.

❗️ HIVEX connects domestic merchants to overseas mobile-payment services without requiring separate technical integration for every wallet. TBCASoft, which operates the platform, said UnionPay App payments became available at HIVEX-enabled PayPay locations in early September. TBCASoft described the service as reaching more than 500 million linked UnionPay card users. The figure represents cards linked across UnionPay’s issuing network, not confirmed users of PayPay merchants in Japan.

Xi Jinping used his meeting with Trump at the White House to call for closer communication between Washington and Beijing, warning that growing rivalry between the two powers must not spiral into a military confrontation.

Speaking at the start of the summit, Xi argued that the United States and China should maintain open and sustained dialogue despite their differences. He said greater mutual understanding, trust and cooperation could help the two countries avoid what is known as the “Thucydides Trap” — the risk of conflict when a rising power challenges an established one.

Xi said both nations would benefit from cooperation and suffer from confrontation. He specifically called for regular communication between the US and Chinese militaries, along with stronger mechanisms for managing and preventing crises.

The Chinese leader also pointed to areas where the two countries could build closer ties. Among his proposals was an invitation for 100,000 young Americans to travel to China over the next five years for educational and exchange programs.

The appeal comes as Washington and Beijing remain locked in intense competition over artificial intelligence, trade and technology, while tensions surrounding Taiwan continue to complicate the broader relationship. 

Both governments have imposed tariffs and other restrictions on trade, while the US has tightened controls on advanced semiconductor technology and equipment exported to China.

Trump, meanwhile, welcomed Xi and Chinese first lady Peng Liyuan to the White House, describing his relationship with the Chinese president as a strong personal friendship. 

The US president said the two sides had made progress on several issues, including efforts to create what he described as a more balanced trading relationship and expand market access for American farmers and ranchers.

Trump also said security, technology and artificial intelligence would be among the subjects discussed during the visit. He has recently used the term “super intelligence” to describe the next stage of AI development.

Xi also emphasized his personal rapport with Trump, saying the two leaders had maintained contact and developed mutual respect. He said both sides should work toward a stable and constructive relationship and steer US-China ties in a predictable direction.

The White House summit followed a highly ceremonial welcome for Xi, who arrived in Washington with Peng Liyuan. Trump had personally traveled to Andrews Air Force Base the previous evening to greet the Chinese leader upon his arrival.
Despite the diplomatic pageantry, the meeting comes against the backdrop of significant strategic competition. 

Washington continues to restrict China's access to advanced chips, semiconductors, software and chip-making equipment, while trade tensions remain unresolved.

A temporary US-China tariff truce that was due to expire in November has also been extended until February, according to US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent. 

The extension keeps negotiations between the world's two largest economies open as both sides seek further concessions.

The talks in Washington therefore combine diplomatic outreach with continuing economic and technological rivalry, with Xi presenting dialogue and crisis-management mechanisms as key tools for preventing competition from turning into direct conflict.

🔔 Zcash price holds above $1,200 as sell signal appears 

➡️ Zcash price traded near $1,216 on Sep. 10 after a seven-day rally of more than 50%, but overbought momentum, a three-day sell signal and nearby liquidation clusters raised the risk of a pullback. According to data from cryptonews, Zcash price was trading at $1,216.15 at the time of writing, down 2.26% for the session after opening at $1,244.18. The token traded between an intraday low of $1,204.93 and a high of $1,256.80.  

📊 Despite the daily decline, ZEC remained one of the strongest large-cap crypto performers over the past week. Its price rose more than 50% from around $814 on Sep. 4 and briefly entered the $1,249–$1,257 area before buyers lost momentum. The breakout also placed Zcash above $1,000 for the first time in years. Price continued to hold more than $200 above the psychological level at the time of writing, even as Bitcoin and Ethereum faced broader selling pressure.

⚡️ Derivatives liquidations contributed to the initial acceleration. More than $34.5 million in ZEC short positions were reportedly closed during a 24-hour period as bearish traders were forced to buy back the asset. Short liquidations accounted for about 94% of the total cited liquidations. Forced buying helped ZEC clear resistance quickly, but the same leverage that drove the advance could increase volatility if traders begin taking profits.
